role: small red words: the lead-in words spread across the frame (you / would / not / wanna) and the line justified under a title (your current lifestyle)
notes: Same red and same absolute blur as the titles (thin strokes therefore peak at about 157 instead of 199). The 2.8 px blur makes the family ranking soft (the top six fonts are within 15 percent, and single words flip, e.g. Poppins wins on 'lifestyle'); the weight is clear (700; 600 is 50 percent worse). Google Sans Bold keeps one family with the subtitles. Word gaps are far wider than a space: 2.0 em between the words of each pair and 4.4 em across the centre in 'you would | not wanna'; 0.81 em (justified to the title's width) in 'your current lifestyle'.
